notes.title: Play again our mini games
notes.notes: With this update 3.0 you can play again minigames. Once you will finish any of minigames we have in Back to 1998 you can run them again from home screen. Try again in our challenging Hanger game outside playing with kids, or our arcade Maze game when you need to hit 999 points or fight with boss in Kate castle.

notes.title: We've added dialog skip option
notes.notes: We believed that point & click adventure is based on dialogs but we know from our players that you would like to skip dialogs from time to time. You can now do it with right mouse click. Soon we will also add this option to game controllers.

notes.title: Save game has arrived!
notes.notes:
We've added [b]save game option[/b] on some checkpoints in the game. 

Whenever there is a time to get achivement also the game will be saved. So if you run Back to 1998 again it will restore moment of save with all your collected marbles and inventory items.

This version have also full support of Chinese translation as we're visiting Games Fusion in Beijing this week.

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
We've posted critical update (Windows build) for players with game controller. For some of them there was issue on outdoor scene that make game crashed. Also playing minigame in the room was limited only to gamepad. You can now play using keyboard even if gamepad is connected.

Have a lot of fun and nostalgia with Back to 1998.
